title: BAM pendulum recordings for Dynamixel MX-64, MX-106, XL-320, XL-330 and Feetech STS3215 (7.4 V)
authors: Grégoire Passault (Gregwar, bucket owner); Rhoban BAM contributors
version: 5 bucket objects, uploaded 2026-07-16 to 2026-07-20; SHA-256 per archive in archive-receipts.csv
finding: All five archives opened. The XL330 has 358 logs, 224744 samples and 60 enabled samples at the normalized Present PWM boundary. MX load is a firmware estimate. STS3215 load is a recording placeholder. Each retains angle references and encoder positions.

title: Waveshare ST3025 raw BAM actuator identification recordings
finding: 135 closed-loop and torque-off recordings total 179987 samples. The enabled sin_time_square condition spans raw load values −1000 to +1000. The recorder checks the torque-limit setting, but the raw load field is not a shaft transducer in Nm.

title: MangDang MD-300-150 three-output module identification logs

title: Unitree J288 single-servo hybrid control pendulum identification logs
finding: 131 logs contain 779531 points. When both per-row feedback gains are zero, 13 logs have nonzero feedforward commands covering 60184 enabled samples; residuals are tabulated per file. Torque feedback is calculated by the servo from current.

title: Feetech HLS2915 position-mode BAM raw identification logs
finding: 64 position_voltage traces total 76024 samples across four mass/arm combinations. The current readout and calculated signed terminal voltage are separate fields. The data branch and recorder correct the obsolete filename and mode details in the PR description.
rights: Public immutable data commit. Data-branch README checked without an explicit licence grant for raw logs. Publish independent aggregates and links only.
